notes.title: Patch 1.12.1
notes.notes:
In some cases it wasn't possible to unlock the 1% achievement. This problem is solved now.
If you had this problem and your "earned Money" stat got stuck, it should now trigger the achievement once you reach the 1 million $.

notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.notes:
Version 1.11

BugFixes

    'bigger storage' option now stays active after loading a game
	
	
New Stuff

    the Church now allows donations in exchange for reputation
    Cosco discovered the internet. You can now buy Items from your computer (for double the price)
